recommendations.overall_recommendation_summary: To improve your CV and job matching for the position at SynergisticIT, focus on enhancing the clarity of your skills section, adding measurable results to your projects, and developing missing required skills such as Spring Boot, Docker, and Microservices.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Organize Skills Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: The skills section lacks clear organization, which can hinder readability and impact. A well-structured skills section can help highlight your qualifications more effectively.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis indicates that the skills section lacks clear organization and grouping.

recommended_actions.action_description: Organize the skills section into categories such as Programming Languages, Tools, and Soft Skills for better clarity.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: Improved readability and clarity of skills, making it easier for recruiters to assess qualifications.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Add Measurable Results to Projects
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Including measurable outcomes or results in project descriptions can demonstrate the impact of your work and enhance your CV's effectiveness.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis notes that no measurable results or quantifiable achievements are provided in project descriptions.

recommended_actions.action_description: For each project, add specific outcomes or results achieved, such as performance improvements or user engagement metrics.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: Increased impact of project descriptions, showcasing your contributions and effectiveness.
